kubernetes.reason: The existing Node provider verifies real signed Clerk JWTs with the SDK; the new optional audience restriction remains on that provider.

evidence.testName: Clerk audience verification with actual SDK and signed JWTs preserves legacy authentication when no audience restriction is configured

aws-lambda.reason: Reuse the existing Node/Lambda provider and shared auth contract; no Lambda-specific implementation or runtime claim is added.
constraints: Invocation scope, callback isolation and telemetry flush/close remain the selected Lambda host responsibility.
This change has no live AWS or Clerk deployment evidence; Node SDK tests do not certify Lambda infrastructure.

cloudflare.reason: Package-wide Cloudflare support is unclaimed in the catalog. Only the opt-in /workers authentication subset is executed in workerd; full SaaS deployment, webhooks and administration are outside that proof.
constraints: Native nodejs_compat is required; the SDK browser/Web Crypto path is bundled.
Each authenticated request fetches a fresh Clerk session; upstream availability, rate limits and latency apply.
Synthetic local upstream and signed workerd fixtures do not establish live Cloudflare/Clerk certification.
Roles and permissions retain the signed token lifetime; applications own route authorization, tenant target and cookie/cache policy.
